story_zh: 小明今天很高兴，他想去游泳。但是他的身体很累，还觉得冷。妈妈说他可能生病了，要休息。小明听了妈妈的话，准备吃药。吃完药，他睡觉了。睡完觉，他觉得很快乐，身体不累了。
story_pinyin: Xiǎomíng jīntiān hěn gāoxìng, tā xiǎng qù yóuyǒng. Dànshì tā de shēntǐ hěn lèi, hái juéde lěng. Māma shuō tā kěnéng shēngbìng le, yào xiūxi. Xiǎomíng tīngle māma de huà, zhǔnbèi chī yào. Chī wán yào, tā shuìjiào le. Shuì wán jiào, tā juéde hěn kuàilè, shēntǐ bù lèi le.
story_en: Xiaoming is very happy today, he wants to go swimming. But his body is very tired, and he feels cold. Mom says he might be sick and needs to rest. Xiaoming listens to his mom and prepares to take medicine. After taking the medicine, he sleeps. After sleeping, he feels very joyful, and his body is no longer tired.
